title: Late or Early: 才 vs 就, 才 + small number, 都…了, 一…就…
description: 才 = later / less than expected (no 了), 就 = earlier / sooner (with 了), 'only five', 'already twelve o'clock', and 'as soon as'.

points.title: Time + 才 vs 就
points.summary: Time + 才 + verb = not until (late, more than expected) — no 了. Time + 就 + verb + 了 = as early as (sooner than expected).
points.body:
- 他十点**才**起床 (He didn't get up until ten).
- 他六点**就**起床**了** (He got up as early as six).
examples: I didn't get here until eight.

points.title: 才 + number: only
points.summary: 才 + number = only (fewer / younger / cheaper than you'd think).
points.body:
- 他**才**十八岁.
- 这个班**才**五个学生.

points.title: 都 + time + 了: already
points.summary: 都 … 了 = already (and that's a lot / late).
examples: It's already midnight — how come you're still up?

points.title: 一 A 就 B: as soon as
points.summary: Subject + 一 + A，就 + B = as soon as A, B (or: every time A, B).
points.body:
- 我**一**到家**就**给你打电话.
- 他**一**喝酒**就**脸红.
examples: I'll call you as soon as I get home.

notes: 都 needs 了 and a plural sense.
就 = early — clashes with 太晚了.
questions.translation: He didn't get up until ten — far too late.

notes: 才 doesn't take 了 — and it means late.
questions.translation: He got up at six — earlier than everyone.

notes: That would be 会 / 要.
都十八岁 would need 了 ('already eighteen').
questions.translation: He was only eighteen when he started university.

questions.prompt: {这个|zhège}{班|bān}（　）{五|wǔ}{个|ge}{学生|xuésheng}，{老师|lǎoshī}{很|hěn}{轻松|qīngsōng}。
notes: 还五个 = 'still five' — needs 有.
都五个 would need 了.
questions.translation: This class only has five students — easy for the teacher.

notes: 就十二点了 = 'it'll soon be twelve' — doesn't fit the reproach.
questions.translation: It's already midnight — how come you're still up?

notes: 就三个月了 doesn't fit 还没.
questions.translation: It's been three months already, and he still hasn't written back.
I'll call you as soon as I get home.

notes: 一 goes before the first verb.
就 goes before the second event.
questions.translation: His face goes red as soon as he drinks.
